7.name: Production Hardening
7.notes: Discovered via full codebase recon (2026-02-22). Critical bugs: exposed secrets in .env.local, middleware/.single() crash on missing profiles, dead proxy.ts, missing error boundaries. Tasks ordered by severity: CRITICAL → HIGH → MEDIUM. Panel wiring gap closed 2026-05-25: all 8 panels wired in (app)/page.tsx, VaultProvider mounted, auth state passed to FeedShell. Missing DB migrations added (posts, post_likes, post_comments). SESSION 2026-05-29 repairs: (1) Phase 3 encryption/autofill/e-signature was silently broken — useSecureProfile queried nonexistent table secure_profiles; form_signatures table absent; both masked by (supabase as any) casts. Fixed via Strategy B: vault hooks wired into form-wizard + forms-panel, VaultGuard gate, form_data-nullable migration applied to prod. (2) Critical vault crypto bug: wrapDEK used wrapKey('raw') on non-extractable DEK — vault setup/unlock/rotate always threw. Fixed via envelope encryption (AES-GCM-encrypt raw DEK bytes; in-use key stays non-extractable). (3) document-encryption chunk-offset bug (CHUNK_SIZE vs CHUNK_SIZE+16) fixed. (4) Phase 5/6 document-upload broken: use-documents wrote nonexistent columns (uploaded_at/file_type/application_id) masked by (supabase as any). Fixed in Phase C (regen types + correct columns). (5) npm test now runs 61 tests (was 0 — false-green). (6) P7-T11 auth E2E harness built and committed; execution env-blocked (Node TLS sandbox) — runs via npm run test:e2e on unrestricted env; Google consent = 1 manual step. SOLE REMAINING LAUNCH GATE: P7-T11 human auth e2e (Google OAuth consent screen).
